title: Mildred wanted children; Christmas with Portia
summary: Mildred loved children, met his small daughter Portia on a Christmas Day, and they once considered adoption but waited too long.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: It's a pity, really, like you said she didn't have children, it's such a pity she didn't have children.
Oh, she loved children. It's a shame -- because she did, she really wanted them, but after I was remarried and I had a little redheaded girl --
Yes?
After she'd been sick she came to California, she went out to stay in Bing Crosby's house, I think it was Palm Springs --
Oh.
-- and she was in Van Nuys and she called and said, -- Christmas Day, she said, 'Will you bring Portia over,' and she was a little maybe two-three years old at that time. She was little --
Yeah.
And so we dressed her and I took her over and she just -- oh, she just fell in love with her and she always wanted a little girl.
Yeah. Yeah.
So when we got home, it was Christmas Eve and she called and said Frank Sinatra and Bing Crosby came by with presents and she had a wonderful Christmas Eve.
Oh, that was nice.
I think it's a shame she didn't have children.
Yeah. Well didn't -- you did try to adopt a child, didn't you once, or did you?
We nearly did, yes. But, it was rather late -- it should've been done earlier.
Yeah.
It was --
Which you wouldn't think of it earlier, because you might think you might even have one child of your own.
I Suppose. Until she found out the gland condition wouldn't --
-- prevent it --
Yeah, cause we didn't think that would ever happen. So anyway it got so late that then it was after we stopped working together.
Yeah.
And that was kind of a madhouse in town.
Yeah, I remember.
And with maids and dogs barking and the telephone --
Yeah.
-- ringing which can be that way, it didn't seem quite --
No.
-- yet I think she would've -- sometime I've wondered since if we had went ahead like some other people, like Johnny Mercer and some --
Yeah.
-- adopted -- it might have been different, too. It might've been much different.
Yeah, it might have, Red. It might have --
